race.description: Ladbrokes More On Tote Win Hcp (Bm78)
race.comment: LAST COMMAND (1) is perhaps going better than his form reads but finds a nice race to put it all together fourth-up. Likes the track and trip and is drawn perfectly. Bold showing anticipated. LIBERTY PARK (4) picked straight back up from where he left off last prep, arriving just in time to score at a big price at Doomben. Form around him stacks right up but he is meeting LAST COMMAND worse at the weights this time, which could prove decisive. JUST IN TIME (7) brings solid Sydney form and is rock-hard fit now. Maloney's booking is a good push; suspect he'll roll forward on the mare and have her handy. BLAZEN BOOTS (3) has gone better than the form guide reads in his two runs back. Gets in well with the 3kg claim and is in the mix third-up.
